profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Curology

positions.title: Technical Lead, Shopify
positions.description:
Managed the development and day-to-day operations of both headed and headless Shopify storefronts.
Lead the technical development of General Motor's OnStar self-service ecommerce, built using Shopify Hydrogen, which generates over 1mil in new subscriptions every week. 
Grew shop.onstar.com into new markets, leading the multi-market technical strategy leveraging Shopify Markets.
Managed a team of onshore and offshore developers, providing direction and technical documentation to hit bi-weekly sprint goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Shopify Plus · Shopify Hydrogen · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Tailwind CSS · TypeScript · React.js · Documentation

positions.title: Senior Manager & Developer, Ecommerce
positions.description:
•	Created excise tax calculators for online checkouts utilizing modern JavaScript, PHP, and API library communication techniques.
•	Reduced tech stack cost by over 75% and developed automations to increase fulfillment center productivity.
•	Designed and built Shopify Plus 2.0 storefronts with custom checkouts and CRM integrations.
•	Researched and implemented custom-built SEO optimizations.
•	Planned and executed weekly marketing campaigns and social media posts.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS Flexbox · Teamwork · Team Leadership · Online Marketing · Server Side · Microsoft Word · API Development · PHP · Shopify · Digital Marketing · Microsoft Excel · Business Process Improvement · Web Services API · REST APIs · Online Advertising · Customer Service · React.js · Project Management · HTML5 · Attention to Detail · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Online Retail · E-Commerce · WordPress · MySQL · User Experience (UX) · Web Experience · Microsoft Office · Marketing · Git · Problem Solving · Embedded JavaScript (EJS)

positions.title: Senior Ecommerce & Marketing Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed, pitched, and created new UX modules using HTML/CSS/JavaScript that resulted in over 100% increases in customer conversions.
•	Researched and implemented custom-built SEO optimizations.
•	Rebuilt BigCommerce and Magento marketplaces to improve application integration and core web technologies.
•	Coordinated, planned, and executed marketing campaigns with executive marketing manager

positions.title: Website Developer
positions.description: Developed new websites and web applications to generate online sales and customer engagement. Performed all duties including promotional campaign implementation and regular reporting to executive management.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Maintained and built client websites on WordPress (WooCommerce), Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, and Squarespace.
•	Developed integrations between online retail platforms and external ERP systems like NetSuite.
•	Used modern web frameworks like REACT and Node.js to create dynamic and interactive online user interfaces.

positions.title: Videographer and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
I am all about the multimedia field. I have formal training and experience in: 
- Shooting and editing of video ranging from band demo reels to TV-ready commercials
- Graphic and Web design
- Flash and Adobe After Effects animation
- Photography and photo retouching
- Application programming/design
positions.insights: Skills: Video Production · HTML5 · Attention to Detail · WordPress · User Experience (UX) · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Multimedia Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Managed the marketing and growth of 80+ retail stores nationwide and online.
•	Developed a new online storefront to better service the unique customer base.
•	Designed, pitched, and created new UX modules using HTML/CSS/JavaScript that resulted in over 100% increases in customer conversions.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS Flexbox · Teamwork · Team Leadership · Video Production · Digital Marketing · Web Services API · Online Advertising · Customer Service · HTML5 · Attention to Detail · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Online Retail · WordPress · User Experience (UX) · Web Experience · Microsoft Office · Marketing · Problem Solving

positions.title: Creative Voice Video Journalist and Motion Editor
positions.description:
I go out and capture arts-related events around the Detroit and Ann Arbor areas, conducting interviews and putting together 2-4 minute highlight reels. These reels get uploaded to the Creative Voice YouTube channel and, on average, receive 100-300 views.

I also work closely with the engineer who created the iPad app that we use to capture and edit video. It's been my responsibility to test and provide feedback on this app, utilizing my background in Computer Science to cohesively communicate with our developer so that we can create an application that's stable and efficient.
positions.insights: Skills: Video Production · Attention to Detail · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Assistant Location Manager
positions.description:
Arrive before main crew and establish the location so that filming can begin quickly and efficiently. I also had to remain after wrap to be sure that the location was left in appropriate order and nothing was left behind.

Communicate with the community around the set to prevent interruptions to filming and negotiate any deals needed for the use of background buildings or vehicles.

Drive and manage the production truck and ensure the landing of the camera truck in a safe location each night.
positions.insights: Skills: Video Production · Attention to Detail · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Marketing Designer
positions.description:
•	Built a company website that features flash animation, social media integration, interactive elements and submission forms. 
•	Created and maintained social media presence on Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn.
•	Redesigned and standardized company image with new sales brochures, email blasts, major magazine advertisements and other marketing pieces.
•	Organized multiple PDS-sponsored lunch & learn events that successfully drove attendance generation.
•	Created and managed company newsletter that gets sent to over 2000 clients and leads monthly.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS Flexbox · Teamwork · Digital Marketing · Online Advertising · HTML5 · Attention to Detail · Online Retail · User Experience (UX) · Microsoft Office · Marketing · Problem Solving
